errors.text_span: 每个维度包含一个柱状图
errors.evidence: The figure is a single grouped bar chart with four categories on the x-axis. Describing each category group as a separate bar chart ('一个柱状图') is structurally incorrect.

The description does not provide any approximate numerical scores for the bars (e.g., ranges or specific high/low values for any category), which is the primary information conveyed by the chart. It only states that the scores can be read from the y-axis.
The description omits the text 'Ignore 1-5' which is present in the bottom-left corner of the chart area.
